sql: CALL s3.system.rewrite_data_files(table => 'bench.events', strategy => 'binpack', where => "((system.bucket(8, key) = 0 AND dt = DATE '2026-11-30') OR (system.bucket(8, key) = 1 AND dt = DATE '2026-11-30') OR (system.bucket(8, key) = 3 AND dt = DATE '2026-11-30') OR (system.bucket(8, key) = 4 AND dt IN (DATE '2026-11-29', DATE '2026-11-30')) OR (system.bucket(8, key) = 5 AND dt IN (DATE '2026-11-02', DATE '2026-11-29')) OR (system.bucket(8, key) = 6 AND dt IN (DATE '2026-11-02', DATE '2026-11-29')) OR (system.bucket(8, key) = 7 AND dt IN (DATE '2026-11-02', DATE '2026-11-29', DATE '2026-11-30')))", options => map('min-input-files', '5', 'partial-progress.enabled', 'false'))
